# Reducer corpus

Original, synthetic recordings shaped after the named tool output families. Version labels document the grammar covered by these fixtures, not a claim that those tool versions were executed to capture them. These fixtures retain Apache-2.0 licensing under the repository's LEGACY_LICENSE, independently of the current application license. Failure evidence, Unicode, structured number precision, skipped/cancelled counts and repeat preservation have independent assertions. Unsupported future formats remain unchanged.

The separate `captured/` directory contains **actual executed local command output** for all nine reducer families, with a manifest of versions, argv, exit status, platform, source hashes for the added Jest/JSON/log inputs and byte counts. Regenerate using `pnpm exec tsx scripts/capture-fixtures.mjs` after installing the locked development dependencies. The script creates original deliberately failing code in a disposable temporary directory, runs installed Vitest/Jest/TypeScript/ESLint/Git/ripgrep binaries and two original Node JSON/log emitters, masks outputs and normalizes only temporary/repository absolute paths. It never installs dependencies itself. The emitters use authored data and fixed log timestamps; these are coverage fixtures, not representative production traffic. stdout/stderr remain separate on disk. Preservation tests replay them as stdout followed by stderr; this concatenation does not assert original cross-stream chunk order. No commits, user repository commands, model calls or global configuration changes are made.
